text: おいしそうな　たべものが　いっぱい　はいってそう！

structure.jp: おいしそうな　たべものが
いっぱい　はいってそう！
structure.en: looks like lots of it is inside!

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そう put on the end of a describing word or a verb says 'it looks that way' from what you can see. おいしそうな　たべもの = 'food that looks delicious'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: はいって is short for はいっている, the state of being inside; the い is dropped in casual speech, and そう adds 'looks like'. はいってそう = 'looks like it's in there'.
